name: PostNitro
description_en:
PostNitro designs social carousels, single-image posts and short animated videos using templates, a freeform editor, brand kits and AI assistance. It can export files for manual posting or, on eligible plans, schedule directly to connected social accounts. Its API, MCP and CLI expose the same design workflow with a separate credit allowance.

Evaluate design, publication and automation as three scopes. A free design account does not include scheduling or API use, and an API add-on does not by itself grant publishing rights. AI text tokens, generated-image allowances, download quotas and per-slide API credits are different limits.
description_zh:
PostNitro通过模板、自由画布、品牌套件和AI辅助设计社交轮播、单图及短动画视频，可导出文件手工发布，符合条件的套餐还能定时发到已连接社交账户。API、MCP及CLI提供相同设计流程，但有独立积分额度。

应分别评估设计、发布及自动化：免费设计账户不含定时或API，API附加包本身也不授予定时发布权限。AI文本token、生成图像、下载数和按页API积分是不同限制。

core_features.explanation_en: Start from a topic, text or article, then refine slides, layouts and brand styling before exporting.
core_features.explanation_zh: 可从主题、文字或文章开始，导出前调整页面、布局及品牌样式。

core_features.name_zh: 符合条件的直接定时发布
core_features.explanation_en: Creator+ and Team+ include connected-account scheduling; Free and Starter remain design/export plans.
core_features.explanation_zh: Creator+及Team+含连接账户定时发布，Free及Starter主要提供设计/导出。

core_features.explanation_en: API/MCP/CLI use per-slide credits, separate from AI image and text allowances.
core_features.explanation_zh: API/MCP/CLI按页消耗积分，与AI图像及文本额度分开。

pricing.summary_en: Free 5 watermarkeddownloads/month, no API/scheduling.Paidmonthly Starter $15, Creator+$30, Team+$60; API add-on $10 with 250 creditsonpaidplan. Plus includescredits/scheduling; tax, currencycodeandannualcheckoutneedconfirmation.
pricing.summary_zh: 免费每月5次带水印下载，无API/定时。付费月价Starter$15、Creator+$30、Team+$60；付费版可加$10/250API积分。Plus内含积分及定时，税/币种代码/年付结账需确认。

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Review the outline and final slide sequence
sections.title_zh: 审阅提纲及最终页面顺序
sections.en:
For an illustrative five-slide product explainer, supply a short topic or approved text, choose the brand kit, review the proposed structure and edit the resulting slides. The current homepage describes an outline-approval step, editable copy/layout and PNG/PDF/MP4 output. Keep a saved editable design as well as a rendered file if another editor must revise it. No carousel was generated or downloaded in this research.

The topic tutorial documents a Topic tab, a short prompt and language/slide settings, but still names older models and a general 4–20 slide range. The current plan page is more specific: Free allows up to 5 AI slides, Starter 8, Creator+ 15 and Team+ 20. Treat that older tutorial as a workflow example, not permission to exceed the selected plan.
sections.zh:
例如五页产品说明，可输入简短主题或获准正文、选择品牌套件、审阅结构后编辑生成页面。当前首页描述先批准提纲、可编辑文字/布局，以及PNG/PDF/MP4输出。若需交给其他编辑者修改，应同时保留可编辑设计及渲染文件；本次未生成或下载轮播。

主题教程描述Topic页签、短提示及语言/页数设置，但仍列旧模型和通用4–20页范围。当前套餐更具体：Free最多5AI页、Starter8、Creator+15、Team+20，应将旧教程仅作流程示例，不能据此超出套餐。

sections.title_en: Match the design and account quotas to the workflow
sections.title_zh: 让设计及账户额度匹配流程
sections.en:
Free includes one brand kit and 5 downloads/month with a watermark, without scheduling or API. Monthly paid prices display $15 Starter, $30 Creator+ and $60 Team+, subject to tax; yearly billing is advertised as two months free, but a final yearly checkout/currency code was not verified. Paid cards offer a 3-day trial, distinct from the continuing free plan.

Starter has 30 downloads/month, 400 K AI text tokens and 5 AI images, without scheduling. Creator+ has unlimited downloads, 1.2 M tokens, 50 images, 10 social accounts and 200 API credits. Team+ lists 5 workspaces/5 members, 2.4 M tokens, 100 images, 30 accounts, 500 API credits and 15 brands/templates/palettes. Unlimited downloads do not mean unlimited generation, API use or connected accounts; confirm how additional limits are billed.
sections.zh:
免费版含一个品牌套件、每月5次下载和水印，不含定时/API。付费月价显示Starter$15、Creator+$30、Team+$60，另加适用税；年付宣传免两个月，但本次未核实最终全年结账或币种代码。付费卡片提供3天试用，与持续免费版不同。

Starter每月30下载、400K AI文本token及5图像，无定时；Creator+不限下载、1.2M token、50图像、10社交账户及200API积分；Team+列5工作区/5成员、2.4M token、100图像、30账户、500API积分及15品牌/模板/调色板。不限下载不等于生成、API或连接账户无限，扩容计费需确认。

sections.title_en: Price a slide-based API job separately
sections.en:
The developer access offer is a $10/month add-on on a paid main plan with 250 credits, or included credits in a Plus plan. Thus Starter plus the add-on displays $25/month for 250 credits without scheduling, whereas Creator+ displays $30 with 200 credits and scheduling. These are different combinations, not a claim that the add-on includes every Plus capability.

Importing a slide costs 1 credit and generating a slide with AI costs 2; the pricing FAQ illustrates a six-slide AI deck at 12 credits. Generated images use another allowance. Confirm the quota period, rollover, retry charges and whether renders/other operations cost credits before automation. No key was created, package installed, paid API call executed or connector authorized.
sections.zh:
开发访问为付费主套餐上每月$10附加包、含250积分，或Plus套餐内含积分。因此Starter加附加包显示每月$25、250积分、无定时，Creator+显示$30、200积分且含定时，是不同组合，不能认为附加包包含全部Plus能力。

导入每页1积分、AI生成每页2积分，FAQ举六页AI轮播12积分；生成图像用另一额度。自动化前需确认额度周期、结转、重试及渲染/其他操作是否收费。本次未创建密钥、安装包、执行付费API或授权连接器。

sections.title_en: Distinguish a valid schedule from successful publication
sections.title_zh: 区分有效定时任务与实际发布成功
sections.en:
Current pages list direct scheduling for Linked In, Instagram, Tik Tok, Threads, Facebook Pages and Pinterest boards. Creation presets for X/Reddit do not establish direct scheduling to them. Each destination has its own account and media/settings requirements. Verify a draft first, then confirm the scheduled status and actual destination result; review AI facts, media rights and any required disclosure before posting.

The API error reference separates 422 request validation, 401 authentication/workspace problems, 402 plan entitlement and relayed business errors. It documents past dates, accounts outside the workspace, required designs/settings and platform-specific constraints. Repair the actual error rather than repeatedly submitting the same invalid request. API acceptance or a generated file alone is not proof that a social post appeared. None of these actions were tested.
sections.zh:
当前页面列LinkedIn、Instagram、TikTok、Threads、Facebook Pages及Pinterest boards直接定时。X/Reddit创作预设不证明可直接定时到这些平台；各目标有自身账户、媒体及设置要求。应先检查草稿，再核对定时状态和实际目标结果，发布前复核AI事实、媒体权利及必要标注。

API错误文档区分422请求校验、401认证/工作区、402套餐权限及上游业务错误，列过去日期、非本工作区账户、缺设计/设置和平台专属限制。应修复真实错误，不能重复提交同一无效请求。API接收或文件生成本身不证明社交帖子出现，本次未测试这些操作。

sections.title_en: Separate editable work, output rights and account closure
sections.title_zh: 区分可编辑工作、输出权利及关户
sections.en:
The published terms are dated May 20, 2024. They retain user ownership of uploaded material while granting the service the rights needed to operate it, require users to have upload rights and reserve the platform/software IP to PostNitro. A rendered design or a CLI package is not evidence that the hosted service is open source. Stock, fonts, audio and AI outputs still need their applicable rights checked.

The terms and pricing FAQ describe cancellation effective at the next billing date and a 7-day purchase refund that immediately ends granted licenses. The terms separately describe permanent account deletion, so cancellation, refund and deletion should not be treated as one action. Confirm design retrieval, future scheduled posts, connected-account revocation and current contract terms before closing an account. No cancellation, deletion, retention or licensing outcome was tested.
sections.zh:
公开条款日期为2024年5月20日，保留用户上传材料所有权，同时授予运营所需权利，要求用户具上传权，并将平台/软件知识产权留给PostNitro。渲染设计或CLI包不证明托管服务开源，素材、字体、音频和AI输出仍需核对适用权利。

条款及定价FAQ描述取消于下一账单日期生效、购买7天内退款并立即终止许可；条款另述永久删除账户，因此取消、退款及删除不能当作同一动作。关户前需确认设计取回、未来定时帖子、连接账户撤销及当前合同。本次未测试取消、删除、保留或许可结果。
